card.name: Ending of vaccination as a heading
card.fires_on: The ending piece of the word vaccination or vaccinations, especially when it starts a section heading in a drug label. It also fires weakly on endings of a few other split words.

modes.label: Vaccination heading
modes.description: The ending of Vacc-ination(s) opening a label subsection on live vaccines.
modes.example: 4 Vacc<<ination>> Administration of live or live attenuated vaccines

modes.label: Other split words
modes.description: Endings of other long words broken into pieces, such as pigmentation, tripling or powering.
